regime.note: mini CPU run — shape of the curve, not final numbers

readings: Refinements stack up through L3: selectivity, channel-decay (Kimi's finding reproduced: channel > head), local conv (largest single gain).
Even at the ladder's best pure rung (L3, 0.035) the recurrent family sits at ~1/2 the transformer and ~1/4 our hybrids — the hybrid thesis holds at tout-egal, at every rung.

L4 (+delta-rule) REGRESSES when pure (0.016) — yet the same delta-rule inside our hybrid reaches 0.129: the delta-rule appears to pay only when combined with attention. A candidate finding for the whitepaper; needs 1500 steps + multi-seed before any claim.
claim_discipline: compared to 'GLA + named rungs', never to 'Mamba'; an official pre-trained recurrent remains a separate non-equalised reference.
